description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a value for this parameter on your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. \`ClientToken\` can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each request is unique.

description.zh:
流日志的描述信息。
> 描述可以为空或长度为 0～256 个字符，不能以 http://或 https://开头。
description.en:
The description of the flow log.

> The description can be empty or 0 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`.

description.zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

- **true**：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

- **false**（默认值）：发送正常请求。
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: performs a dry run to check the request without modifying service resources.

- **false** (Default): sends the request.
The ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR) instance.

description.zh:
流日志名称。
> 名称可以为空或长度为 0～128 个字符，不能以 http://或 https://开头。
description.en:
The name of the flow log.

> The name can be empty or 0 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`.
The ID of the VBR instance.

description.zh:
网络实例的类型。取值：
- **VBR**：边界路由器实例。
description.en:
The type of the network instance. Valid value:

- **VBR**: a virtual border router (VBR) instance.

description.zh:
流日志捕获流量的捕获窗口时长。单位：秒。取值：

- **60** 
- **600**

默认值：**600**。
description.en:
The aggregation interval for a flow log to capture traffic. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

- **60**

- **600**

Default value: **600**.

description.zh:
存储捕获流量的 Logstore。
- 如果您已经在当前地域创建了 Logstore，您可以输入已创建的 Logstore 的名称。
- 如果您未在当前地域创建 Logstore，您可以为 Logstore 自定义名称，系统会帮您自动创建 Logstore。 Logstore 名称。其命名规则如下：

- 同一个 Project 下，Logstore 名称不可重复。
- 只能包括小写字母、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。
- 必须以小写字母或者数字开头和结尾。
- 长度为 3~63 字符。
description.en:
The Logstore that stores the captured traffic.

- If you have created a Logstore in the current region, enter the name of the Logstore.

- If you have not created a Logstore in the current region, specify a custom name for the Logstore. The system automatically creates the Logstore. The naming conventions for the Logstore name are as follows:

- The Logstore name must be unique within the same project.

- It can contain only lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_).

- It must start and end with a lowercase letter or a digit.

- It must be 3 to 63 characters in length.

description.zh:
存储捕获流量的 Project。
- 如果您已经在当前地域创建了 Project，您可以输入已创建的 Project 的名称。
- 如果您未在当前地域创建 Project，您可以为 Project 自定义名称，系统会帮您自动创建 Project。


Project 名称在阿里云地域内全局唯一，创建后不可修改。其命名规则如下：
   
- Project名称必须全局唯一。
- 只能包括小写
- 字母、数字和短划线（-）。
- 必须以小写字母或者数字开头和结尾。
- 长度为 3~63 字符。
description.en:
The project that stores the captured traffic.

- If you have created a project in the current region, enter the name of the project.

- If you have not created a project in the current region, specify a custom name for the project. The system automatically creates the project.

The project name must be globally unique within an Alibaba Cloud region and cannot be modified after it is created. The naming conventions are as follows:

- The project name must be globally unique.

- It can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

- It must start and end with a lowercase letter or a digit.

- It must be 3 to 63 characters in length.

- The length must be 3 to 63 characters.

description.zh: 流日志实例所属的资源组ID。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the flow log instance belongs.

The sampling ratio. Valid values:

- **1:4096**

- **1:2048**

- **1:1024**

Default value: **1:4096**.

description.zh:
标签。

最多可以绑定20个标签。
description.en:
The tags.

You can add up to 20 tags.

description.zh: 资源的标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en: The tag key of the resource. If you specify this parameter, you cannot leave it empty. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs: and cannot contain http\:// or https\://.

description.zh: 监听的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en: The tag value. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with acs: and cannot contain http\:// or https\://.

description.zh: 当前字段代表需要投递的project所属region信息，仅跨地域投递需要填写该字段，  非跨地域投递不需要填写该字段。
description.en: The region of the project to which you want to deliver logs. This parameter is required only for cross-region log delivery.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun expressconnectrouter create-flow-log --ecr-id ecr-mezk2idmsd0vx20000 --dry-run false --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-000000 --flow-log-name myFlowlog --description myFlowlog --instance-type VBR --instance-id vbr-xxx --interval 60 --sampling-rate 1:4096 --project-name flowlog-project --log-store-name flowlog-logstore --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --resource-group-id rg-aek2aq7f4va0000 --target-sls-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun expressconnectrouter CreateFlowLog --region cn-hangzhou --TargetSlsRegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Tag.1.Key TestKey --Description myFlowlog --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aek2aq7f4va0000' --InstanceId 'vbr-xxx' --ProjectName 'flowlog-project' --DryRun false --SamplingRate '1:4096' --FlowLogName myFlowlog --LogStoreName 'flowlog-logstore' --EcrId 'ecr-mezk2idmsd0vx20000' --Tag.1.Value TestValue --ClientToken '02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-000000' --InstanceType VBR --Interval 60
